Who We Help  /  Small Businesses

Keep the doors open and the lights on.

What we take off your plate

When it breaks

Registers, printers, phones, wifi, and the machine in the back office that everything depends on.

Before it breaks

Backups you can actually restore from, updates that happen on schedule, and spare-parts planning.

Your staff

Short trainings so your team can handle the small stuff and knows when to escalate.

Vendor wrangling

Dealing with the internet provider, the point-of-sale company, and whoever built your website in 2014.

How we'd start

We start with a walkthrough, not a contract.

  1. 01 A walkthrough. We come look at what you actually use during a normal day, and take notes.
  2. 02 A short list, in priority order. The things that would hurt most if they failed, and what each one costs to fix.
  3. 03 A rhythm that works for you. Call-us-when-you-need-us, or a standing block of hours each month. Your choice.

Want a number you can call on a bad day?

Hourly, short-term, and long-term arrangements are all available, with sliding-scale rates quoted when we talk.
